features.name: Project intake
features.description: Create a project from a raw natural-language request.

features.name: Requirement understanding
features.description: Extract business goal, users, scenarios, pain points, and boundaries.

features.name: Input/output contract analysis
features.description: Identify input sources, process steps, outputs, formats, consumers, unknowns, and source types.

features.name: Gap confirmation
features.description: Classify unknowns by Level 1/2/3 and block only unresolved Level 3 gaps.

features.name: Feature decomposition
features.description: Convert confirmed requirement contracts into feature modules.

features.name: Capability mapping
features.description: Map each feature to concrete implementation capabilities.

features.name: Technology discovery
features.description: Find candidate libraries or local catalog options for each capability.

features.name: Technology decision
features.description: Score candidates and choose library, custom, hybrid, or defer decisions.

features.name: Blueprint generation
features.description: Emit architecture, API, database, frontend, workflow, deployment, risks, and PRD artifacts.

features.name: Task backlog
features.description: Convert the blueprint into implementation tasks with dependencies and acceptance criteria.

features.name: User-specified capability
features.description: 核心功能包含新增、编辑状态、删除、搜索/筛选、基础统计和本地保存。
